([[Fork Union, Virginia]]) | college = [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton]] (2015–2018) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | highlights = * 2× [[Big East Conference|Big East]] Defensive Player of the Year (2017, 2018) * Second-team All-Big East (2018) }} '''Khyri Thomas''' (born May 8, 1996) is an American basketball player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton Bluejays]]. Thomas attended [[Omaha Benson High School Magnet]] in [[Omaha, Nebraska]]. He committed to [[Creighton University]] to play [[college basketball]].{{cite web|url=http://www.omaha.com/creighton/former-benson-all-stater-khyri-thomas-signs-with-jays/article_76927784-9377-506c-b15c-aaeabc03c3bc.html|title=Former Benson all-stater Khyri Thomas signs with Jays | Creighton|website=omaha.com|accessdate=2018-04-07}} Prior to attending Creighton, he attended [[Fork Union Military Academy]].{{cite web|url=http://www.omaha.com/creighton/former-benson-star-all-nebraska-captain-thomas-coming-home-to/article_60a86954-b2d2-11e4-b877-77028e086fcf.html|title=Former Benson star, All-Nebraska captain Thomas coming home to play for CU | Creighton|website=omaha.com|accessdate=2018-04-07}} As a freshman at Creighton, Thomas averaged 6.2 points, 1.4 assists and 3.7 rebounds per game. As a sophomore, he averaged 12.3 points, 3.3 assists and 5.8 rebounds and was named the Big East Defensive Player of the Year along with [[Josh Hart (basketball)|Josh Hart]] and [[Mikal Bridges]].{{cite web|url=http://www.omaha.com/creighton/mens-basketball/khyri-thomas-shares-league-s-defensive-player-of-the-year/article_e916b8e8-027d-11e7-ac80-aff6af38e62d.html|title=Khyri Thomas shares league's defensive player of the year award with two others | Men's Basketball|website=omaha.com|accessdate=2018-04-07}} As a junior, he averaged 15.1 points, 2.8 assists and 4.4 rebounds and again was named the Big East Defensive Player of the Year.{{cite web|url=http://www.omaha.com/creighton/blog/khyri-thomas-named-big-east-defensive-player-of-the-year/article_4c812c7a-2086-11e8-84b6-132055c07dff.html|title=Khyri Thomas named Big East defensive player of the year (again) | Blog|website=omaha.com|accessdate=2018-04-07}} He entered the [[2018 NBA draft]] without initially hiring an agent, but on May 13 announced he was staying in the draft and forfeiting his final season at Creighton.{{cite news|last1=Johnson|first1=Raphielle|title=Creighton guard Khyri Thomas to remain in 2018 NBA Draft|url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2018/05/13/creighton-guard-khyri-thomas-to-remain-in-2018-nba-draft/|accessdate=May 14, 2018|work=[[NBC Sports]]|date=May 13, 2018}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://gocreighton.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=3819&path=mbb Creighton Bluejays bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Thomas, Khyri}} [[Category:1996 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Nebraska]] [[Category:Creighton Bluejays men's basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Omaha, Nebraska]]
